name: appdev-ip-advisor
description: App-development IP issue-spotter for Claude Cowork — trademark / brand-name clearance, trade dress and visual-style mimicry (including UI elements copied from physical products like film-camera dials, rangefinder controls, hardware bezels), copyright (icons, fonts, music, sound effects, photography, code, AI-generated content), open-source license compliance (GPL/AGPL/MIT/Apache/BSL contagion), right of publicity / likeness / voice cloning, App Store and Play Store IP rules, AI Act labeling. App-development-specific complement to Anthropic's Claude for Legal `intellectual-property` plugin (which covers general IP practice but not the app-store / mobile / UI-mimicry / OSS-license / AI-content checklists app developers hit). Strongly recommends installing Claude for Legal alongside (Cowork → Customize → Browse plugins → Legal) so the plugin can prefer its MCP connectors: Westlaw / Practical Law for live trademark + copyright + AI-Act primary law; CourtListener for case-name lookups in open-jurisdictional-gaps; Box / iManage / NetDocuments / Docusign / Google Drive as asset and license-bundle sources; Microsoft Word for tracked-change output on draft marketing copy or T&Cs. Declares `intellectual-property` as a soft dependency. One Opus-pinned subagent, one skill, one setup command that wires a Cowork Routine on the user's asset / spec / license-bundle inbound folder to triage new uploads. Refuses to opine on software patents — those need a registered patent attorney. Produces issue lists, never verdicts. Every output ends with a non-negotiable take-to-counsel block. Not legal advice.
